query:
SELECT id AS "id!", 'chat'::text AS "function_type!", protected_at AS "protected_at!"
            FROM tensorzero.chat_inferences
            WHERE id = ANY($1) AND protected_at IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT id AS "id!", 'chat'::text AS "function_type!", protected_at AS "protected_at!"
            FROM tensorzero.chat_inferences_archive
            WHERE id = ANY($1) AND protected_at IS NOT NULL
